errors.text_span: и спада до минимум от около -0,20% през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The minimum value in 2015 is stated as approximately -0.20%, but the line clearly drops to a point about halfway between 0.00% and -1.00%, which is approximately -0.50%.
The description fails to mention the flat section between 2010 and 2011, where the inflation rate remains constant at approximately 1.8%.

The term 'stabilizes' is an interpretation of the trend. A neutral description would state the values for 2018 (approx. 1.7%) and 2019 (approx. 1.6%), noting the slight decrease rather than implying stability.
The value for 2019 is stated as approximately 1.70%, but the graph shows a value closer to 1.60%. The value of 1.70% corresponds to the year 2018, after which there is a slight decrease.
